title: Check response (the file a pluggable check writes to $A2DLC_OUT)
description: schema_version 1. What a check declared in config.checks (protocol §5 Checks, ADR meta/0006) reports after running in its image, without network, over /base:ro and /cand:ro with the changed files it matches in $A2DLC_CHANGED. A finding is bound to a file: <file>::<check id> or <file>::L<line>. The check never reports an error about itself: a missing or invalid file, a non-zero exit, a missing image or a timeout are recorded by the core as status error (never a pass). A check can lower the verdict, never raise it; the only override is a signed waiver with decision accept_finding on the finding's target.

id.description: The id of config.checks it answers for; another id is a core error.

status.description: ran: it examined the files and judged. not_applicable: nothing to judge in the files it received (pass true, no findings); the core also records not_applicable, with the count, when 0 changed files match.

pass.description: false whenever there is a finding.

target.description: <file>::<check id> for a file-level finding, <file>::L<line> for a line.

tool.description: What produced the findings, for the verdict's reader.
